The phone is partially folded, showing both the outer screen and the inner foldable screen.
Photo 2 shows the inner screen turned on, displaying Android UI with app icons and a notification 'Can't reach the Internet'.
A pink sticker is visible on the back in photos 0 and 1, with handwritten text that appears to say 'Pixel 10 Pro Fold' and '256GB'.

No storage capacity is visible on the device or in the UI. The sticker in photo 0 says '256GB', but this is handwritten and not confirmed by the device's settings or any official label.

risks.proof: A clear shot of the device's settings menu showing the model name, or a shot of the box or packaging with the official model name.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic foldable smartphone, not a Pixel, with lower value

A video of the device folding and unfolding smoothly.
